import html # Example template; in a real application this would be defined elsewhere. BLOG_FORMAT = "

{title}

{body}
" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑generated blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string containing the formatted title and body. Raises ------ ValueError If either `title` or `body` is empty after stripping whitespace. """ if not title.strip(): raise ValueError("Title cannot be empty.") if not body.strip(): raise ValueError("Body cannot be empty.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
